summary: The tree callback's directory option (default ~/.ansible/tree) sets where per-host JSON files go, also set by --tree.
questions: Where does the tree callback write its files by default?

answer_card.title: tree callback directory
answer_card.answer_md: `directory` (path, default `~/.ansible/tree`, 2.11+): where the per-host JSON files go. Also set by `--tree` in ad hoc mode.
